purpose: Registry of conformance suites that traceability and threat entries may name as conformance:<name> (ADR-0130 rule 10). 'specified' = the spec document holds a pass/fail case list; 'planned' = the spec document states the rules a future case list must test. A scope listed here cannot be authorized while the suite is still planned; the validator enforces both.

suites.name: provider
suites.description: Home provider cases PC-A..PC-I (capabilities, multi-tenancy, quotas, sponsorship, migration, recovery, discovery, failure, release integrity).

suites.name: network_transport
suites.description: NetworkTransport cases NT-01..NT-05: untrusted byte carrier, failover without semantic change.

suites.name: identity
suites.description: AccountID stability and continuity behavior across provider changes.

suites.name: discovery
suites.description: Descriptor resolution, caching and discovery fallbacks.

suites.name: attachments
suites.description: Attachment references, blob integrity and expressive-asset refs.

suites.name: security_floor
suites.description: Peer-local floors, advisory validation, expiry and override rules.

suites.name: identifier_spoofing
suites.description: Confusable identifiers and reserved display surfaces.

suites.name: performance
suites.description: Performance budgets exercised as conformance checks (V-022 measures them).

suites.name: ui_intents
suites.description: Typed UI intents and PlatformAdapter capability families.

suites.name: ui_themes
suites.description: Theme compiler, reserved surfaces and font sanitization.

suites.name: publication
suites.description: Publication seq chain, revocation and rollback rejection.
